data.name: Zerem
data.gender_notes: Zerem is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Hebrew language, Zerem means 'remembrance' or 'memory'. This name has a rich biblical background, as it is mentioned in several Old Testament passages. The name Zerem carries the meaning “Remembrance, memory” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zerem usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance, memory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Serving as a reminder of God's love and presence in our lives.
data.etymology: Zerem belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance, memory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zerem total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: זרם
in_hebrew.meaning: זרם - שפע מים זורם, מעיין, פליטת מים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זרם הוא שם עברי שפירושו שפע מים זורם, מעיין או פליטת מים. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'זרם' שפירושו זרימה או שפע מים. בהקשר המקראי, השם זרם עשוי להיות קשור למושגים של שפע, רעננות וזרימה.

in_greek.name: Ζήρημ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζήρημ είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει ροή, ρεύμα ή καταβρύση. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα Ζήρημ πιθανότατα συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'ζήρω' που σημαίνει ρέω ή κυλώ. Στο πλαίσιο της χριστιανικής παράδοσης, το όνομα Ζήρημ μπορεί να συμβολίζει τη ροή της πνευματικής ανανέωσης και της χάριτος.

in_latin.name: Zerem
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zerem in lingua Latina significat fluxus, rivus, vel emanatio. Etymologia nominis Zerem probabiliter connectitur cum voce Hebraea 'זרם' quae significat fluxus vel emanatio. In traditione christiana, nomen Zerem potest significare fluxum gratiae vel spiritualis renovationis.

in_english.name: Zerem
in_english.meaning: Zerem - flowing stream, emanation, or outpouring
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zerem originates from Hebrew roots, signifying a flowing stream, emanation, or outpouring. It is associated with the Hebrew word 'זרם' (zerem), meaning a flowing stream or an outpouring. In the biblical context, Zerem may symbolize an abundance of spiritual blessings or a flowing stream of divine favor. Historically, the name Zerem has been used in Christian traditions to signify a source of spiritual nourishment or a symbol of God's overflowing love.

pronunciation.biblical: זרם (Zerem) - pronounced as 'zeh-REHM' in a biblical Hebrew context

data.cultural_impact: The name Zerem has resonated through history, particularly within Jewish and Christian communities. In Jewish tradition, the Fast of the Firstborn, also known as Yom Hazikaron Le'Gan Eden (or "The Day of Remembrance for the Departed"), memorializes the Exodus from Egypt. The name Zerem is mentioned in Exodus 13:15, which instructs the Israelites to commemorate thePassover with a lamb, whose blood would serve as a "zerem," a remembrance, of the prayers for God’s protection during the exodus. In Christian tradition, the commemoration of Christ's death and resurrection through the Eucharist is a "Zerem," a remembrance and a symbolic reenactment of His sacrifice.
data.spiritual_significance: As a reminder of God's faithfulness and the profound importance of memory within religious observance, the name Zerem holds deep spiritual significance for both Jewish and Christian communities. Zerem carries an profound reminder of our connection with our past, our forebears, and the preservation of our spiritual legacy. It embodies the idea that remembrance fosters devotion, growth, and an ongoing relationship with the divine. In a personal sense, the name can serve as a reminder of God's love, mercy, and the valuable memories that shape our lives. Each time someone with the name Zerem hears it, they can be reminded of the importance of cherishing the connections and memories that expand their spiritual beautifully.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zerem, meaning "scattered" in Hebrew, symbolizes the Christian belief in God's infinite love and mercy that extends even to the most scattered and lost souls. It is a reminder that no matter how far one strays, God's grace remains ever present, waiting to gather and heal.

historical_references.reference: Zerem, a biblical figure mentioned in the Book of Jeremiah, is believed to be a priest who lived during the time of King Josiah in Judah (640-609 BC). He is described as a 'faithful man put in charge of the temple', and is praised for his devotion to God and his efforts to reform the cultic practices in Jerusalem.
historical_references.context: Biblical figure, priest, King Josiah, temple, Judah

historical_references.reference: Zerem, a medieval Christian monk and scholar, is best known for his commentary on the book of Jeremiah in the 11th century. He was a Benedictine monk from the monastery of Morimund in the Alpine region, and his commentary was widely used in the Middle Ages for its clarity and insight into the biblical text.
historical_references.context: Medieval Christian monk, scholar, commentary on Jeremiah
